verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's first-party docs describe a ninth-gen NVENC hardware encoder that accelerates video exports and AI effects in DaVinci Resolve and Adobe Premiere. They also cite NVIDIA Studio as delivering creator performance in video editing, 3D rendering and graphic design, so the core of creator-app acceleration is documented. However, the pack never names AV1 or HEVC codec support, and there is no independent corroboration of encode performance. Missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC encoder/decoder specs, Studio driver or ISV-certification details, hands-on or independent creator-workload evidence.
